pairs.target: yǔ luò le yíyè , tǎ wéi zǎochén xiàlóu , kànjiàn láng xiàbǎi le yìpái xié , xié jiān dōu cháowài , xiàng bǐ tāmen xiān lái lǐng huó .
pairs.english: It rained all night. Coming downstairs in the morning, Tavi saw shoes lined under the gallery, toes pointing out as though they had come for work before everyone else.
pairs.hanzi: 雨落了一夜，塔维早晨下楼，看见廊下摆了一排鞋，鞋尖都朝外，像比他们先来领活。

pairs.target: yù hé zhàn zhe kàochuāng de xiǎozhuō , bǎ zuótiān mǎi de huājiāo fēn jìn liǎngzhī dài .
pairs.english: Yuhe occupied the small table by the window, dividing yesterday's pepper into two bags.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾占着靠窗的小桌，把昨天买的花椒分进两只袋。

pairs.target: tā méi wèn tǎ wéi zěnme bǎ zuǐ suān chéng nàyàng , zhī tuī lái yìbēi wēnshuǐ .
pairs.english: She did not ask how Tavi had made his mouth so sour, only pushed over a cup of warm water.
pairs.hanzi: 她没问塔维怎么把嘴酸成那样，只推来一杯温水。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hē le bànbēi , zhǔdòng jiāodài le guǒzǐ de shì , tā tīng wán xiào , shuō zìjǐ zuórì lùguò nà piàn shù , kànjiàn mǎndì luòguǒ , jiù zhīdào méi rén huì dāng tián guǒ chī .
pairs.english: Tavi drank half and volunteered the fruit story. She laughed, saying she had passed those trees yesterday and seen fallen fruit everywhere, which told her nobody ate it as sweet fruit.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝了半杯，主动交代了果子的事，她听完笑，说自己昨日路过那片树，看见满地落果，就知道没人会当甜果吃。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě bù zǎo shuō . "
pairs.english: “You could have said so sooner.”
pairs.hanzi: “你也不早说。”

pairs.target: " nǐ méi wèn . "
pairs.english: “You didn't ask.”
pairs.hanzi: “你没问。”

pairs.target: jīnrì yuándìng shōuhuí yíkuài búyòng de jiù zhǐlù bǎn . tā bèi xīn pái tì xià , zàn fàngzài mài bù pù hòu , mùjiàng yào chāidiào huài jiǎo , liúxià néng yòng de mùliào .
pairs.english: Today they were meant to collect an unused old direction board, replaced by the new sign and stored behind the cloth shop. The carpenter would remove its broken feet and save usable timber.
pairs.hanzi: 今日原定收回一块不用的旧指路板。它被新牌替下，暂放在卖布铺后，木匠要拆掉坏脚，留下能用的木料。

pairs.target: yǔ lǐ bùhǎo bān , ruǎn héng biàn ràng tāmen děngdào wǔhòu , yòu jiāng zuówǎn wūdǐng lòu xiàlái de shuǐpén wǎng chuángbiān nuó le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Moving it in rain was awkward, so Ruan Heng told them to wait until afternoon and moved the basin catching last night's roof leak a little nearer his bed.
pairs.hanzi: 雨里不好搬，阮衡便让他们等到午后，又将昨晚屋顶漏下来的水盆往床边挪了一点。

pairs.target: zhǎngguì cóng lóutīkǒu kànjiàn , shuō pén yǐjīng jiē dé zhù , jiào tā bié bànyè zài nuó , nuó piān le shuǐ fǎnér quán lòu dào wàitou .
pairs.english: The innkeeper saw from the stairs and said the basin already caught the drips; no moving it at midnight, or an off-center basin would spill everything outside instead.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜从楼梯口看见，说盆已经接得住，叫他别半夜再挪，挪偏了水反而全漏到外头。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng róu zhuóyǎn , chéngrèn zìjǐ zuóyè shēn jiǎotī fānguò yícì . yù hé bǎ huājiāo zhā hǎo , shùnshǒu jiāng tā de xié cóng pén biān ná kāi .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng rubbed his eyes and admitted kicking it over in the night. Yuhe tied up the pepper and moved his shoe away from the basin.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡揉着眼，承认自己昨夜伸脚踢翻过一次。郁禾把花椒扎好，顺手将他的鞋从盆边拿开。

pairs.target: yǔ xiǎo le yǐhòu , tǎ wéi dào pù hòu zhǎo mùjiàng .
pairs.english: When the rain eased, Tavi went behind the shop to find the carpenter.
pairs.hanzi: 雨小了以后，塔维到铺后找木匠。

pairs.target: xīn péng hái wěnwěn lì zhe , shéng méi héng chū shíjiē , bù gūniáng zhèng yòng chánggān jiāng bù dǐng jī de shuǐ bō xiàqù . tā kànjiàn tā , xiān bǎ gān shōuhuí lái , miǎnde jiāo tā yìtóu .
pairs.english: The new awning still stood firm, no rope crossing the steps. The cloth seller was pushing pooled water off its top with a long pole; seeing him, she drew it back to avoid drenching him.
pairs.hanzi: 新棚还稳稳立着，绳没横出石阶，布姑娘正用长杆将布顶积的水拨下去。她看见他，先把杆收回来，免得浇他一头。

pairs.target: jiù zhǐlù bǎn yǐ píng fàngzài jiàshàng , mùjiàng què méi jí zhe chāi , ná zhe yígè xīn zuò de mù kòu gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: The old direction board lay flat on a rack, but instead of dismantling it, the carpenter showed him a newly made wooden latch.
pairs.hanzi: 旧指路板已平放在架上，木匠却没急着拆，拿着一个新做的木扣给他看。

pairs.target: mù kòu yìduān tào zhe kě chōu de xiāo , lìngyìduān yā zhe lùpái jiǎo biān de xié chēng .
pairs.english: One end of the wooden latch held a removable pin; the other pressed the diagonal brace beside the sign's foot.
pairs.hanzi: 木扣一端套着可抽的销，另一端压着路牌脚边的斜撑。

pairs.target: kòuxià , xiāo tuīrù , zài sōngshǒu , chēnggān biàn wěnzhù le . méiyǒu rén yòng jiè xìng , tǎ wéi rènchū nà zhèngshì qiánxiētiān bùhǎo fàng luó jiá de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Latch down, pin in, hands released: the brace stayed firm. Nobody used property borrowing, and Tavi recognized the spot where a screw clamp had been awkward days ago.
pairs.hanzi: 扣下，销推入，再松手，撑杆便稳住了。没有人用借性，塔维认出那正是前些天不好放螺夹的位置。

pairs.target: " duō zhàn le yìdiǎn dìfāng . " mùjiàng zhǐzhe wàitou tūchū de yìjiǎo ,
pairs.english: “Takes a little more room.” The carpenter pointed to a protruding corner.
pairs.hanzi: “多占了一点地方。”木匠指着外头凸出的一角，

pairs.target: " dàn chāi de shíhòu búyòng děng nǐmen huílái . ruò lín jiǔ le zhàng zhù , hái dé xiāo , yǎnxià xiān biétì wǒ shuō quán hǎo le . "
pairs.english: “But no waiting for you to come back to take it apart. If prolonged rain swells it tight, it'll need shaving. Don't claim I've fixed everything yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “但拆的时候不用等你们回来。若淋久了胀住，还得削，眼下先别替我说全好了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxià kàn le bàntiān , wèn néng bunéng ràng zìjǐ chāi yìhuí .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched to examine it for a while, then asked to take it apart once himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下看了半天，问能不能让自己拆一回。

pairs.target: mùjiàng bǎ xiāo dìgěi tā , tā dìyīcì méi táiqǐ kòutóu , yìngtuī le liǎngxià , mùjiàng shēnshǒu yāzhù : " xiān sōng zhèbiān , bùrán nǐ yuè tuī , tā yuè yǎo . "
pairs.english: The carpenter handed him the pin. His first try failed to lift the latch head, and he shoved twice before the carpenter stopped his hand. “Release this side first, or the harder you push, the tighter it bites.”
pairs.hanzi: 木匠把销递给他，他第一次没抬起扣头，硬推了两下，木匠伸手压住：“先松这边，不然你越推，它越咬。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàozhe zuò , xiāo yí xiàhuá chūlái , chàdiǎn luò jìn ní lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi followed the instructions; the pin slipped out and almost fell into the mud.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维照着做，销一下滑出来，差点落进泥里。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn jiē zhù , bèihòu gūniáng xiào dào , yàoshi diū le , zhènghǎo ràng mùjiàng zài zuò dìèrzhī .
pairs.english: He hurried to catch it. The seller laughed behind him: losing it would give the carpenter a chance to make a second.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧接住，背后姑娘笑道，要是丢了，正好让木匠再做第二只。

pairs.target: mùjiàng shuō dìèrzhī kě dé suànqián , bié bǎ tā jīn zǎo de gōngfū dàngzuò yǔ lǐ pào chūlái de .
pairs.english: The carpenter said the second would cost money; his morning's labor had not simply soaked out of the rain.
pairs.hanzi: 木匠说第二只可得算钱，别把他今早的工夫当作雨里泡出来的。

pairs.target: tāmen jiāng mù kòuliú zuò shìyòng , yuánlái de kòujiàn réng guī yuánlái de páizi , shuí yě méi bǎ tā dàngchéng báifèilìqi .
pairs.english: They kept the wooden latch for a trial, the original clasp remaining with its sign; nobody considered that earlier work wasted.
pairs.hanzi: 他们将木扣留作试用，原来的扣件仍归原来的牌子，谁也没把它当成白费力气。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bāng zhe shōuzǒu jiù bǎn , jià shàngkōng chūlái , gūniáng bǎ gāng cháo le biān de bù pù zài shàngmiàn , zuǐlǐ hái niàn zhe děng tiānqíng xiān jiāng nǎ pǐ guàchūqù .
pairs.english: Tavi helped remove the old board. On the freed rack the seller spread cloth with freshly damp edges, still deciding aloud which length to hang out first when the weather cleared.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维帮着收走旧板，架上空出来，姑娘把刚潮了边的布铺在上面，嘴里还念着等天晴先将哪匹挂出去。

pairs.target: huí kèzhàn shí , lóuxià zhuōbiān yǒu yìfēngxìn , fēngkǒu shì tā rènde de wāi zhé .
pairs.english: Back at the inn, a letter lay by the downstairs table, sealed with a crooked fold he recognized.
pairs.hanzi: 回客栈时，楼下桌边有一封信，封口是他认得的歪折。

pairs.target: sè lā shōudào nà zhāng xiě dēngé de xiǎo zhǐ le , xiān shuō tā ruò jì jǐgè fāguāng de chóng huílái , zìjǐ juébú tì tā yǎng ;
pairs.english: Sela had received the little note about lantern moths and began by saying that if he sent glowing insects home, she would certainly not keep them for him.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉收到那张写灯蛾的小纸了，先说他若寄几个发光的虫回来，自己决不替他养；

pairs.target: yòu shuō ā duó lái sòng guò shuǐ , qiáojiàn tā yòng jiùyī biān gěi línjiā háizi gǎi xiùkǒu , fēi yào cāi nà kuài bù yuánlái shì shuí de , cāi cuò liǎngcì , zuìhòu jiāng zìjǐ de pò xiù yě gēxià le .
pairs.english: She also said Ado had brought water and seen her altering a neighbor child's cuff with old clothing scraps. Insisting on guessing the cloth's former owner, he guessed wrong twice and finally left his own torn sleeve too.
pairs.hanzi: 又说阿铎来送过水，瞧见她用旧衣边给邻家孩子改袖口，非要猜那块布原来是谁的，猜错两次，最后将自己的破袖也搁下了。

pairs.target: tā méi bǎ xīgài shuō chéng yìdiǎn bù téng , zhī shuō nuǎn qǐlái yǐhòu qǐshēn shùn le xiē , réng bù tái mǎn tǒng .
pairs.english: She did not claim her knees were painless, only that getting up was easier in warmer weather; she still did not lift full buckets.
pairs.hanzi: 她没把膝盖说成一点不疼，只说暖起来以后起身顺了些，仍不抬满桶。

pairs.target: xìn xià bàn wèn tā zhùchù shài bu shài dédào tàiyáng , xǐ guò de yīfu bié zhī kàn miànshàng gān , lǐngkǒu lǐ hái cháo zhe jiù chuān , yǎng qǐlái zìjǐ shòu .
pairs.english: The letter's lower half asked whether his lodging got sun. He should not judge washed clothes by dry surfaces; wear them with a damp collar and he would bear the itching himself.
pairs.hanzi: 信下半问他住处晒不晒得到太阳，洗过的衣服别只看面上干，领口里还潮着就穿，痒起来自己受。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào zhèlǐ , xiàyìshí mōlemō lǐngkǒu . zuóyè xǐ de yīfu zhèng dā zài yǐbèi , xiǎnglái hái méi gān .
pairs.english: Reading this, Tavi instinctively felt his collar. Last night's washed clothes hung over the chair back, probably not dry yet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到这里，下意识摸了摸领口。昨夜洗的衣服正搭在椅背，想来还没干。

pairs.target: tā jiāng xìn yā hǎo , xiān qù bǎ yīfu fān le miàn , zhǎngguì zài ménwài kànjiàn , kuā tā zǒngsuàn zhīdào yǔtiān bùnéng zhī tú zhěngqí guà yìpái .
pairs.english: He secured the letter and turned the clothes over. Seeing him from the door, the innkeeper praised him for finally knowing a neat row was not enough in rain.
pairs.hanzi: 他将信压好，先去把衣服翻了面，掌柜在门外看见，夸他总算知道雨天不能只图整齐挂一排。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn tā gěi sè lā xiě huíxìn , shuō chóng méi zhuā , zhùchù chuāngzǐ qíng shí jiàn dédào guāng , zhèchǎng yǔ lǐ kànbújiàn .
pairs.english: That evening he replied to Sela: he had caught no insects, and his window saw sunlight in fair weather, though not in this rain.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚他给瑟拉写回信，说虫没抓，住处窗子晴时见得到光，这场雨里看不见。

pairs.target: yòu xiě zìjǐ qiánrì qù gāochù yǒuxiē pà , hòulái hǎo le ; jīnrì jiàn mùjiàng zuòchū búyòng jiè xìng de kòu , zìjǐ chāi le liǎnghuí , méi nòng diū xiāozǐ .
pairs.english: He also wrote that the heights had frightened him two days ago, then he felt better. Today he had seen the carpenter's latch needing no property borrowing and dismantled it twice without losing the pin.
pairs.hanzi: 又写自己前日去高处有些怕，后来好了；今日见木匠做出不用借性的扣，自己拆了两回，没弄丢销子。

pairs.target: tā xiě dào zhèlǐ tíng le yíxià , jiāng " liǎnghuí " gǎichéng " yìhuí ", yǒuxiē hǎoxiào , yě yǒuxiē xiǎng jiā .
pairs.english: He paused here and changed “twice” to “once,” a little amused and a little homesick.
pairs.hanzi: 他写到这里停了一下，将“两回”改成“一回”，有些好笑，也有些想家。

pairs.target: xìn liànggān hòu , tā fàngjìn dài jì lán , lìngfù le qián .
pairs.english: After the letter dried, he put it in the outgoing basket and paid separately.
pairs.hanzi: 信晾干后，他放进代寄篮，另付了钱。

pairs.target: yǔ yòu mì qǐlái , lóuxià yǒurén nuó xié , nuó lái nuó qù , zuìhòu háishì shèng tā nà yìshuāng cháozhe shuǐpén .
pairs.english: The rain thickened again. Someone downstairs moved the shoes back and forth, leaving his pair still pointing toward the basin.
pairs.hanzi: 雨又密起来，楼下有人挪鞋，挪来挪去，最后还是剩他那一双朝着水盆。
